claims: The Artemis II Orion spacecraft reentered Earth's atmosphere on April 10, 2026, at approximately 7:53 p.m. ET (4:53 p.m. PT).
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft experienced a six-minute communications blackout during peak heating.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego at 8:07 p.m. ET.
Artemis II service module separation occurred at 7:33 p.m. ET on April 10, 2026.
Artemis II entry interface (reentry start) occurred at approximately 7:53 p.m. ET on April 10, 2026.
Artemis II drogue parachute deployment occurred at approximately 8:03 p.m. ET on April 10, 2026.
Artemis II main parachute deployment occurred at approximately 8:04 p.m. ET on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II mission concluded after a 10-day journey.
The Artemis II crew traveled farther than any human in history.
